moves.name: Long check
moves.design_role: High-poke challenge with a compact body on [6,17). Keeps slower14/3/19 timing,85damage/110stun,shorter reach and no kara versus free Long Heel. Lows,throws,early startup and standing recovery answer it; no invulnerability.

hurtbox_windows.intent: Compact high-poke challenge after six vulnerable startup ticks; legs and throws remain exposed.
Low body and attacking limb; no strike/projectile invulnerability.
Return to full standing body immediately on recovery; extended limb can be punished.

moves.name: Step feint
moves.design_role: Six-tick duck-step then ten exposed commitment ticks;16total,13600forward displacement. Slower travel than walking, no attack/cancel/guard/invulnerability. Requires high-poke timing and loses to low attacks,throws and delayed punishment.

hurtbox_windows.intent: Brief committed duck-step under high pokes; low body and throw vulnerability remain.

moves.name: Sway feint
moves.design_role: Eight-tick upper-body lean with12800root retreat, then eight exposed commitment ticks. A high-poke spacing bait; shorter root travel than walking, no attack/cancel/guard/invulnerability. Lows,throws,deep reach and delayed attacks remain answers.

hurtbox_windows.intent: Upper-body retreat while grounded legs remain exposed; not universal invulnerability.

resource_notes: Only this player's persistent credits fund EX/super startups and preparation leases. No earned gauge, prepaid uses, or team account.
